24.original: Survey the designated location and defeat any challengers that appear.

48.original: You're part of the Third Promise's retinue, aren't you? Not many could stand a chance against Gulool Ja Ja in combat, shade or not. Been eager for a chance to take the measure of you.

49.original: The young warriors who once trained here have long since left the forest in search of work. But Whetstone still has plenty of fighting spirit.

50.original: Sure, we're all getting on in years, but we fought hand-to-hand with the Xbr'aal during the war. Our scales are stronger than steel.

51.original: Care to test your mettle against Mamook's finest? I'll gather my comrades and meet you north of here. When you're ready, come and find us─and once victory's been decided, we'll meet back here.

58.original: A victory worthy of your accolades, stranger. I only hope my hip makes a full recovery...

59.original: Whetstone was once a gathering of young blood eager to sharpen their scales. Ah, to be young again...

60.original: You've done an admirable job on your own scales, if I do say so myself. Does an old warrior proud.

61.original: I suppose our time on the field is well and truly done. Now, we must do what we can to pass on our knowledge to those who would learn it.

62.original: You have my thanks. My comrades and I will learn from our battle, and see that Whetstone hones the scales of many a young warrior to come.
